articles.summary: Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ: SBUX) today announced that Brian Niccol, chairman and chief executive officer, will participate in a keynote fireside chat at the 6th Annual Evercore Consumer and Retail Conference on Tuesday, June 9 th , 2026, at 11:40 a.m. Eastern Time. The fireside chat will be webcast live from the company’s Investor Relations website at https://investor.starbucks.com on the Events Presentations page. About Starbucks Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to responsibly sourcing and roasting high-quality arabica coffee. Today, with a global footprint of more than 41,000 company-operated and licensed coffeehouses and a growing presence in consumer-packaged goods, we are the world's premier purveyor of specialty coffee. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup. To share in the experience, please visit us in our stores or online
articles.title: Starbucks to Participate in the 6th Annual Evercore Consumer and Retail Conference
